title: Support vector regression trained on inherited Alzheimer's predicts sporadic progression
summary: Support vector regression on CSF, MRI, amyloid-PET and FDG-PET biomarkers was trained in autosomal-dominant Alzheimer's disease (n = 121) and cross-validated in sporadic prodromal AD (n = 216). The combined-modality model predicted 4-year decline in global cognition (R2 = 24%) and memory (R2 = 25%). Model-based risk enrichment reduced the sample size needed to detect simulated treatment effects by 50%-75%.
